name: @sayoriqwq/effect-harness
description: Effect v4 beta Prelude provider profile and source route package.

scripts.source:status: node ../partita/dist/bin/partita.js pin status --root . --contract repos/effect.subtree.json --name effect --prefix repos/effect && node ../partita/dist/bin/partita.js pin status --root . --contract repos/tsgo.subtree.json --name tsgo --prefix repos/tsgo
scripts.source:update: node ../partita/dist/bin/partita.js pin update --root . --contract repos/effect.subtree.json --name effect --prefix repos/effect --dry-run && node ../partita/dist/bin/partita.js pin update --root . --contract repos/tsgo.subtree.json --name tsgo --prefix repos/tsgo --dry-run
scripts.source:verify: node ../partita/dist/bin/partita.js pin verify --root . --contract repos/effect.subtree.json --name effect --prefix repos/effect && node ../partita/dist/bin/partita.js pin verify --root . --contract repos/tsgo.subtree.json --name tsgo --prefix repos/tsgo
